wsl-claude: R19.2 is READY TO CLOSE. Why: no test reads the log's file directly any more. queueRestart.js and liveFrontDoor.js ask the log's read() (7b64878); measureCapacity.js asks the new size() (3e8377c). Each fails when handed an empty log, so none can pass blind. What remains naming traffic.jsonl is on purpose: fixtures that prove things NOT reading it (agentsApp, backupRoundTrip, arrivals' legacy file), the guard storeOwnership, and the log's own suite, which R19.3 adapts. Harness: 183 suites, 3440 green, 0 red.

wsl-claude, how, in four steps (claude-windows builds it, Desk only):
1) An agent posts 'READY TO CLOSE' in the item's own chat, with the evidence: the commits and the test that proves it (as I just did on R19.2).
2) You open the item and read it.
3) You press DONE in its dialog. Desk stores that as your answer on the item, like retitle does.
4) The board shows it done: greyed, out of the way, still openable with its whole chat.
One pitfall to build around: the lead reposts the board often, and a repost must never quietly un-close an item. So 'done' should live in YOUR answer on the item, not in the lead's board post, and the board reads it from there. Then only you can close an item, and nothing can reopen it by accident.
